familySettings.use: every spare of a puzzle, paired (same seeds at every spare)
familySettings.pooling: Production pooling (batch_evaluate.js rate mode, empirical_confirm.js, task11_rerate.js): two meter calls {setting:'family', runs:20, seeds:2} at seed 4711 and seed 18427, 40 campaigns each, pooled = (exp4711 + exp18427) / 2. Production rated the reference bot's 4711 call with capture:'tail' (part of the cache key, not of the rating); Codex rated key memory without capture. The yardstick looks up both cache variants before measuring.
familySettings.visibleCampaigns: The meter returns per-campaign results only for the first sub-block of each call (the first 20 of 40). SEs are estimated from those 40 of 80 campaigns (sample SD / sqrt(80)); D itself uses all 80 (mean of the two calls' expectedTries).
